crossRefs.note: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to…

translations.web: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
translations.bsb: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
translations.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
